lessons.title: Build: A Pencil Hydrometer
lessons.focus: Weight a pencil with clay, float it, mark fresh-water line, calibrate with salt solutions; test unknowns.
lessons.advanced: Calibrate marks at 1.00, 1.05, 1.10 g/cm³: describe how you verified each.

lessons.title: Layers of Liquid: The Egg in Salt Water
lessons.focus: Egg sinks in fresh, floats in strong salt solution; density columns (salty below fresh, carefully poured).
lessons.advanced: Compute the salt concentration needed for neutral buoyancy of an egg (ρ≈1.05 g/cm³) — method and caveats.

lessons.title: Submarines and Swim Bladders
lessons.focus: Fish adjust a gas bladder; submarines flood and blow ballast tanks; Cartesian diver (Unit 7) as the working model.
lessons.advanced: A submarine at constant depth takes on water: what must happen to its ballast and why?

lessons.title: Rafts, Canoes and Ferries of Kenya
lessons.focus: Banana-stem and ambatch rafts, dugout canoes on Lake Victoria, ferries at Likoni; buoyancy calculations for safe loading.
lessons.advanced: Raft of 10 logs, each 40 L displacement, total mass 150 kg: safe passenger load in kg?

lessons.title: Life Jackets and Water Safety
lessons.focus: How a life jacket adds buoyancy without adding weight; cold water and panic; community water-safety campaign design.
lessons.advanced: A 70 kg person (body density ≈ 1.02) needs how much extra displaced volume to float face-up? Show working.

lessons.title: Plimsoll Lines: Loading Marks on Ships
lessons.focus: Load lines for fresh vs salt water; mark your clay boat's Plimsoll line; overloading tragedies discussion.
lessons.advanced: A ship moves from sea (1.025) to fresh water (1.000): by what percentage does displaced volume change?

lessons.title: Hot Air Rises: Buoyancy in Gases
lessons.focus: Smoke rises; teacher demo tissue hot-air balloon; air has density too; bridge to thermal physics (Unit on temperature in CBE 1.4).
lessons.advanced: Hot air at 0.9 kg/m³ in a 1 m³ balloon, outside 1.2: net lift force in newtons; payload in grams.

lessons.title: Design Project: A Floating Garden or Fish Cage
lessons.focus: Design a buoyant platform for vegetables (jerricans under bamboo); compute buoyancy budget; present.
lessons.advanced: Full buoyancy budget: platform + soil + water + crop vs total displacement, with 30% safety margin.

lessons.title: Unit Review: Regatta Day
lessons.focus: Clay-boat races, hydrometer readings, buoyancy puzzle stations; unit quiz.
lessons.advanced: Championship problem: design a boat to carry 500 g in salt water with minimal clay — show the displacement math.
